description: Arkvory documentation: a self-hosted repository for build artifacts, UPack packages, container images, Git LFS, npm and Unity packages and raw files; installation, operation, backups, mirrors and the HTTP API.
untranslated: This page has not been translated yet and is shown in English.

home.tagline: Self-hosted storage for build artifacts, packages, container images and large files: one server for CI, deployment agents and game teams.

api.name: Name
api.intro: Operations of this group with their access rule, retry rule, parameters and answers. Every request carries a key: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (see Authentication).

accessKinds.account-session: A signed-in account session (not a key)
accessKinds.bootstrap-or-own-key: Bootstrap key, or the key itself
accessKinds.pending-or-active-key: The issued key, before or after activation

retryKinds.idempotent: Safe to repeat: the same request has the same effect
retryKinds.idempotency-key: Safe to repeat with the same Idempotency-Key
retryKinds.compare-and-swap: Repeat only with the expected revision (compare-and-swap)

system.title: System and health
system.intro: Liveness, readiness, metrics, the OpenAPI document and the server's capabilities.

repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.intro: The repositories a caller may see and the details of one.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.intro: Resumable uploads: create an upload session, send the bytes whole or in parts, complete it, and follow its completion job.

artifacts.title: Artifacts and catalog
artifacts.intro: Published artifacts: listing, details, content, annotations, references, search, the catalog audit and its change feed.

packages.title: Packages
packages.intro: UPack packages: registration, listing, versions and downloads by name, version or range.

files.title: Files by path
files.intro: Files addressed by a path in the repository: revisions, history, restore, and raw files in one request.

promotion.title: Stages and promotion
promotion.intro: Stages of an artifact (for example `release`), promotion between repositories and resolution of a stage to a version.

storage.title: Storage policies and retention
storage.intro: Quotas, usage, retention policies, their preview and run, cleanup and deletion of artifacts.

mirrors.title: Mirrors
mirrors.intro: The state of a mirrored repository and the feed a mirror follows.

links.title: Download links
links.intro: Time-limited links that let someone without a key download one artifact.

attachments.title: Build attachments
attachments.intro: Logs, reports and other files attached to an artifact, with their history.

accounts.title: Accounts and sign-in
accounts.intro: Sign-in, sessions, personal access tokens, users, groups and the security audit.

services.title: Service accounts and keys
services.intro: Service accounts for CI and automation, their keys, policies, delegations and audit.

backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: Status, plan, runs, points, verification and retention of the built-in backup agent.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: Update offers from the hub and the request to install one.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Reports with screenshots and logs sent to ProAnimaStudio through this server.

rules.title: Rules
rules.decimal: a whole number in decimal digits, sent as a string

errors.title: Errors
errors.intro: Every failure is a JSON envelope with a stable machine code, an optional reason that refines it, a message for people and the request ID for support. Clients decide by code and reason, never by the message text.
